newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president names new foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president names new foreign minister.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Wednesday named his chief foreign policy advisor Yoo Chong-ha as the country's new foreign minister, a presidential spokesman said.
Yoo replaces Gong Ro-myung who tendered his resignation on Tuesday, citing poor health.

Yoo, 60, has been a career diplomat who served as ambassador to Sudan, Belgium, the European Community and the United Nations before being named as the chief presidential advisor for foreign and security affairs in 1994.
He was also the vice foreign minister between 1990 and 1992.
Gong, who has been suffering from high blood pressure, has been admitted to a Seoul hospital, a Foreign Ministry spokesman said.
